sections.churn_summary: Hold-buffer guards are aligned on the three focus tracks (`exit_confirm_screens=2`, `reentry_cooldown_screens=1`, `min_rebalance_notional_gbp=10.0`), and the latest pass is operationally quiet: `buffered_holdings=0`, `duplicate_day_skip=false`, and `buffer_holds_planned=0` / `reentry_skips_planned=0` on rules, ai_judgment, and momentum_grace, with `last_run.trade_count=0` on each. Lifetime decision-review cost drag remains elevated on control and primary (`rules` `cost_drag` 0.4659 / `trade_count` 80; `ai_judgment` 0.4073 / 62), with watch alerts, though primary still beats control on `excess_after_costs` (−0.3447 vs −0.4167) and epoch-scoped drag is lower on primary than control (`learning_track_epoch_datum`: ai_judgment epoch `cost_drag` 0.2159 vs rules 0.3142). The 7-day buffered-hold replay still favors keeping two confirmation screens: `exit_confirm_screens=1` vs `2` shows `trade_count_delta_lower_minus_higher` −1 and `cost_drag_delta_lower_minus_higher` +0.011 (rules) / +0.0122 (ai_judgment), consistent with the completed extended verdict on `plr-20260901-02`. The single biggest operational learning gap is that `exit_shadow` reports `closed_count` 0 on every track while lifetime drag stays high, so post-exit grace vs screen-rotation evidence still cannot inform guard tuning.

sections.proposed_experiments:
1. [paper_churn] Observe-only 7d rebalance-log replay on rules and ai_judgment with forked `reentry_cooldown_screens`: 2 (live tracks unchanged at 1) over the same window as `buffered_hold_counterfactual` (`replay_from` 2026-09-28 … `replay_to` 2026-10-02) — expected learning value: quantify whether a longer reentry buffer would have changed `simulated_trade_count` / `simulated_cost_drag` without revisiting `exit_confirm_screens` (canonical 1-vs-2 verdict already on `plr-20260901-02`, status done).

2. [monitoring] Weekly epoch readout for momentum_grace after the 2026-10-02 apply (`min_conviction` 0.35) — expected learning value: first post-apply comparison of epoch `trade_count` and `cost_drag` vs rules/ai_judgment once `learning_track_epoch_datum` shows `post_apply_trade_count` ≥1 and `equity_marks` ≥2 (currently 0 / `benchmark_span_available` false).

3. [offline_sim] Add momentum_grace to the buffered-hold counterfactual panel (`exit_confirm_screens` 1 vs 2, same 7d lookback and `churn_context` fields as rules/ai_judgment) — expected learning value: test whether the experimental overlay’s lower lifetime drag (16 trades vs 80/62) changes the screen-count trade-off before any edit to `output/paper_automation/momentum_grace` guard fields in `config.json`.
